about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-l5 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The closing clause that applies to all bullets of paragraph 71 is joined into the last bullet.
findings.evidence: source: "deal with accidents, incidents and emergencies; / the steps must be implemented before the work proceeds." / tree: "• deal with accidents, incidents and emergencies; the steps must be implemented before the work proceeds."

findings.problem: The Principle (f) heading is read as body text and appended to the end of paragraph 111 instead of heading paragraph 112.
findings.evidence: tree: "• may provide no protection when it fails. Principle (f): Check and review regularly all elements of control measures for their continuing effectiveness"

findings.problem: The Principle (g) heading is read as body text and appended to paragraph 113 instead of heading paragraph 114.
findings.evidence: tree: "human behaviour. Principle (g): Inform and train all employees on the hazards and risks from substances..."

findings.problem: Italic subheadings that sit under a main heading are given as siblings of it in heading_path.
findings.evidence: source: "Exposure via the skin (or mucous membranes or eyes)" printed as a subheading under "Adequate control of exposure by routes other than inhalation"; tree: same level

findings.problem: Footnote markers are run into the text as plain (a) and (b), which can be mistaken for list items.
findings.evidence: source: "Health and Safety Executive;(a)" (superscript) / tree: "approved by the Health and Safety Executive;(a) “biological agent”"

findings.problem: The Schedule 2 definitions are given on this page before the table, but they are printed after the table on page 78; this page has only the table rows 1-4.
findings.evidence: tree: "Regulation 4(1) In this Schedule – “aerosol dispenser” means an article..."

findings.problem: The definitions text comes before the table in the tree, but on the page it is printed after the table rows 10 and 11-13.
findings.evidence: source: table rows "10 Hydrogen cyanide" ... then "In this Schedule –" / tree: definitions section before table

findings.problem: Guidance paragraph 309 (under 'Guidance Schedule 2A') is merged into the Schedule 2A regulation text and marked as regulation.
findings.evidence: tree: "(h) Ensure that ... health and safety. 309 Further information on the principles of good practice..." status "regulation"

findings.problem: Numbered paragraphs 4, 5 and 6 of Schedule 3 with their headings are merged into one text section, the headings read as body text.
findings.evidence: tree: "...relates to him personally. 5 Notification of the use of biological agents (1) Subject to..."

findings.problem: The footnote (a) is printed at the top of the page before paragraph 4, but the tree places it after paragraphs 4-6.
findings.evidence: source: "(a) Words substituted subject to transitional provisions as specified by SI 2008/960"

findings.problem: The biohazard sign picture that the regulation text refers to ("the form shown below") has no figure block in the tree.
findings.evidence: source: "shall be in the form shown below –" [biohazard warning triangle] / tree: no figure

findings.problem: The Schedule 5 table footnote (a) is also copied into a Schedule 3 Part I section, so it is attached to the wrong place as well as the right one.
findings.evidence: tree: part-i-text-4 "PART I Provisions of general application to biological agents > Text": "(a) Words substituted subject to transitional provisions as specified by SI 2008/960"
